summary: Checked all 24 estimates against the supplied PDF, extraction-spec.md, and creativity-codebook.md after reading the entire markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-C. All 24 differences match the correct metric rows and Final columns of Table 5 (PDF p. 28). The 12 recorded one-sided Welch-test significance bounds also match the black stars and caption: eleven <0.01 and one <0.05 (byt5, AI-O versus SELF-O). The two recorded MiniLM arm means, AI-O 0.26 and SELF-O 0.22, are printed in Section 5.2 across PDF pp. 8-9. All eight supplied quote-matching alerts are false positives. Direct PDF text, table extraction, and an in-memory rendering of Table 5 confirm: Qwen3-Embedding, AI-O versus SELF-O, −0.005; Style-Embedding, AI-O versus SELF-O, −0.033; compression ratio, AI-O versus SELF-O, −0.083, and AI-T versus SELF-T, −0.100; self bleu, AI-O versus SELF-O, −0.001, and AI-T versus SELF-T, 0.001; rougel, AI-O versus SELF-O, −0.003, and AI-T versus SELF-T, 0.002. The PDF text layer encodes the visible minus sign as U+00B4; table reading order also separates row labels from later columns. The quoted row labels and selected cells are present on the cited page, and no numeric or locator correction is needed. The question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person status, comparison type, and se_basis are supported by the paper. Section 4.1.1 defines one within-cell leave-one-out similarity score per participant, and Section 4.1.2 applies Welch tests to those scores. NGDS alone has higher_is=more_diverse; its original Table 5 signs are correctly retained. The paper does not resolve dependence among these scores or fully specify the compression-ratio and NGDS implementations, as already noted in the extraction. Null analysis counts are justified: recruitment/demographic counts of 200 overall and 50 per cell (PDF pp. 3, 5) are not explicitly reconciled with 29 filtered workers and the post-hoc SELF exclusion (PDF pp. 20, 25). No analysis-specific denominator was inferred. Other arm means and numerical uncertainty are not printed; Figures 2 and 15 show unlabeled points and error bars. No additional in-scope full-sample outcome or contrast was found. The remaining Table 5 columns compare incentives under an unchanged AI configuration, compare two no-AI arms, or concern assistant-generated first drafts; Table 6 conditions on post-treatment adoption. Time trajectories restrict observations to drafts of at least 200 words, and no additional full-sample AI-access contrast is specified. Process measures, self-reports, and qualitative embedding plots are outside the extraction scope. Individual story-quality ratings were not collected (PDF p. 25, Appendix A.4). No confirmed extraction problems.
